extracted.intended_audience: researchers, librarians, institutional administrators, and policy analysts interested in NSF grants and awards data
extracted.subtask_description: A published catalog of National Science Foundation grants and awards for fiscal year 1972, organized for reference (by topic area and by state) and listing project/recipient metadata (investigator, institution, duration, amount). Useful as a bibliographic/dataset resource rather than as application guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization of listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings of the National Science Foundation's grants and awards for 1972 are organized by topic areas, within each topic area the entries are listed by state geographical locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the document's structural rule for presentation: first group grants by topical program/discipline (e.g., Biology, Physics, Social Sciences), and then within each topic group entries are ordered/segmented by U.S. state (and foreign/other categories where applicable). The table of contents and section headings follow this organization (shows topic level headings and sublists by state).

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry content (required fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry contains the name(s) of the person(s) conducting the research, the institution at which the research was conducted and the amount of the grant received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical entries on the pages also include the project title or brief project phrase, program/award code, project duration in months, and occasionally equipment or conference support notes. Example entry elements observed: investigator name(s); institution name; project/award code (e.g., B0i7...); duration (e.g., 12 months, 24 months); dollar amount awarded. Use these fields as the canonical metadata when reproducing or extracting grant records from the volume.
